composition_variation: Create an exquisite original anime illustration of a clearly adult 27-year-old woman strolling along a quiet Mediterranean seaside promenade. She has a graceful oval face, lucid gray-blue eyes, balanced brows, a small straight nose, softly smiling lips, and a poised, independent expression. Her blue-black hair falls to her waist with a tidy side part and a few strands lifted by the sea breeze. Dress her in an opaque ivory short-sleeved linen shirt with a modest open collar, a flowing cobalt ankle-length skirt, flat tan sandals, and tiny silver earrings. Capture the instant she turns her face toward the viewer while taking an easy step; one hand lightly holds a narrow canvas tote close to her hip and the other rests naturally beside her skirt. Low white railings lead toward a distant turquoise bay, with pale limestone paving and just two flowering planters. Cool morning reflections meet warm sunlight on her cheek. Use precise elegant linework, painterly fabric folds, and delicate atmospheric depth. Use an eye-level portrait composition, with one person centered in the middle-to-lower frame and hands held within the central crop. Leave the upper quarter as clean pale sky or light for the lock-screen clock.
